entities.name: Moisès Broggi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Moisès Broggi i Vallès was a Catalan physician and pacifist. Broggi studied medicine at University of Barcelona. He worked as a field surgeon in the Spanish Civil War for the International Brigades.
